market.question: Will US crude oil reserves fall to 275M by June 5?

assessment.reasoning: SPR was ~409M barrels mid-April 2026, having grown earlier in 2026 and only modestly drained recently. Falling to 275M (a 33% drop, ~134M barrels) in ~5 weeks is essentially impossible given physical drawdown rates (max ~4.4M/day, but typical releases far slower). Even an emergency Iran-war release wouldn't get there in time. Market's 0.181 is far too high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether an unprecedented massive emergency drawdown is announced, but even then physical limits prevent a 134M draw in 5 weeks
